title: Mirrors on eggs falling off.
text: Mirrors on eggs falling off.. My package was not damaged but the mirrors are not protected from each other and ALL the eggs are missing strips of mirrors.  I will be able to fix half of them.  So unfortunate because they are very pretty.  I have requested a partial refund.  The missing mirrors are not in the back so I won't be able to fix any of them.
